|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/elitesquadronstorm.html</ref>

There is nothing subtle about this guy. A trooper who's better with blasters than any other trooper who graduated the Academy. Arm him appropriately and he becomes power 3 and fires blasters for 1 less force.

So impressive is the [[Elite Squadron Stormtrooper]]'s qualifications, he inspires the other troopers around him! Forfeit + 2 is a huge bonus for all the other troopers.

Your Biker Scouts are forfeit 6!

Your Elite [[Stormtrooper]] is now power 4, and can fire a +1 weapon that makes it's target forfeit 0 for only 1 Force. He fires cheaper than Ponda does! What's more, your Cadet is forfeit 3 and satisfies all attrition. Talk about protection!
